description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.0015 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Public RPC nodes with failover; no keys. When to use: Use gas to pick the cheapest EVM chain right now or to price a transfer/swap on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon in one call.
